facts.fact: 夺冠夜：Frasier直奔医院，他只想找Logan庆祝
facts.anchor: Because all I wanted was to be with her. To celebrate with her.

facts.fact: 冰上那一眼secret smile：奖杯像两人的共同成就
facts.anchor: But it was the pride radiating from her, the secret smile we’d shared, that had meant everything to me.

facts.fact: 她的“不想结束”终于让两人同页
facts.anchor: Finally, we were on the same page, because I didn’t want it to end either.

facts.fact: 他意识到I loved her——但决定清醒时才说
facts.anchor: She was so confident, so sure of herself, and I loved that about her. I loved her.

facts.fact: 表白计划：必须两人完全清醒时说
facts.anchor: when I finally told her how I felt, I fully intended that both of us would be completely sober.

facts.fact: 与她相比奖杯都只是次奖
facts.anchor: spending time with Logan, seeing her let me in, felt like an even bigger prize than winning the Cup.

facts.fact: 舞池三人夹缝：她用身体告诉他彼此归属
facts.anchor: She might be sandwiched between us, but she was telling me that she was mine. And I was hers.

facts.fact: 她后颈纹了temporary的28号——主动标记
facts.anchor: She had marked herself—with my number.

facts.fact: 她抢先当taker——占有欲与他旗鼓相当
facts.anchor: Apparently, she was just as possessive as I was. I fucking loved it.

facts.fact: body shots的荒诞：当众做亲密动作却假装只是朋友
facts.anchor: She was going to lick salt off my skin, while pretending we were nothing more than friends.

facts.fact: 惯性差点让他当众吻她
facts.anchor: I almost kissed her out of habit, my reflexes begging me to do just that.

facts.fact: Enough sharing. Enough pretending——他拉她回舞池
facts.anchor: While Boone licked the salt from the cleavage of one of the women, I dragged Logan back out to the dance floor.

facts.fact: 互为对手也互为奖赏：冰上与卧室双重较量
facts.anchor: We were good for each other. We challenged each other—both on the ice and in the bedroom.

facts.fact: 低估→夺冠的逻辑迁移到爱情：凭什么不能和Logan在一起
facts.anchor: Everyone had underestimated us, and we’d won. If that was possible, then anything could be possible.

facts.fact: 结尾：巴士上假装朋友的多余与煎熬
facts.anchor: Logan and Holden were deep in conversation about hockey, and I hated that I had to pretend she and I were just friends…when we were so much more.
